item.title: France, Italy, Greece to Help Ensure Red Sea Shipping Transit
item.description: France has reached out to the governments of Italy and Greece to coordinate efforts in the Eastern Mediterranean as tensions over the war in Iran flare, a person close to French President Emmanuel Macron said.

item.title: Russian ‘Shadow Fleet’ LNG Tankers Reroute After Blast Sinks ‘Arctic Metagaz’ in Mediterranean
item.description: Russia’s sanctioned Arctic LNG 2 export network is showing early signs of disruption after an explosion sank one of its shadow fleet carriers in the Mediterranean this week, forcing other tankers to halt or reroute and raising new questions about the security of a key shipping corridor.

item.title: Insurers Say War Cover Still Available for Gulf Voyages as Shipping Crisis Deepens
item.description: War risk insurance for vessels transiting the Persian Gulf and Red Sea remains available despite a wave of cancellations tied to the escalating conflict in the Middle East, according to the International Union of Marine Insurance, offering a limited pathway for ships considering a return to the region.

item.title: Hormuz Crisis Triggers War-Risk Measures for Seafarers
item.description: The global shipping industry is raising urgent warnings about the safety of civilian seafarers as escalating conflict in the Middle East halts commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, strands hundreds of vessels, and forces insurers, labor groups, and shipowners to enact emergency measures.

item.title: World’s LNG System Strains as Qatar Halt Leaves Little Backup Supply
item.description: Companies in the United States and Australia, two of the top global liquefied natural gas producers, have little spare capacity to offset lost supply after Qatar halted production and declared force majeure on shipments due to the conflict in the Middle East, according to Reuters calculations and industry analysts.

item.title: Over 270,000 TEU Stranded as Container Carriers Halt Gulf Cargo Bookings
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of containers are in limbo after ocean carriers suspend cargo bookings to Arabian Container Ports.

item.title: Container Shipping Rates Rise as Asian Factories Reopen—But Hormuz Crisis Threatens New Shock

item.description: President Donald Trump has removed Kristi Noem as Secretary of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, ending a tenure that reshaped several key maritime policies—from historic funding for Coast Guard modernization and Arctic...

item.title: US Sinking of Iranian Warship Piles Pressure on India’s Modi
item.description: The US sinking of an Iranian warship off Sri Lanka’s coast expands the deepening Middle East war to India’s doorstep, unsettling New Delhi’s calibrated approach to the conflict as Iran vowed to avenge the attack.

item.title: U.S. Grants 30-Day Waiver Allowing India to Receive Russian Oil Cargoes Already at Sea
